items.title: Accessory Group
items.description: A group is purely a config-organization construct. Each bulb in the group is exposed as its own HomeKit Lightbulb accessory; there is no group-level HomeKit accessory.

groupName.title: Group Name
groupName.description: Used internally as part of the HomeKit UUID seed for each bulb in the group. Pick something stable; renaming will rebuild the bulbs as new HomeKit accessories.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name in HomeKit. Must be unique within the group.

ipAddress.title: IP Address
ipAddress.description: Static or DHCP-reserved IP. Optional if macAddress is set — the plugin will auto-discover the bulb's current IP via UDP broadcast.

macAddress.title: MAC Address
macAddress.description: Optional. Provide MAC (with or without colons) to identify the bulb across DHCP lease changes.
